# awesome-iran-mcp

> 39 MCP servers (488 tools) that let AI agents search and compare Iranian websites: Digikala, Torob, Basalam, Technolife, MasterKala, Baneh, Shopino, Banimode, Divar, Khanoumi, Asal Banoo, Snappfood, Okala, Tapsi Food, MrBilit, Flytoday, Jabama, Otaghak, Paziresh24, Doctoreto, Taaghche, Fidibo, 30book, Maktabkhooneh courses, Cafe Bazaar and Myket apps, Soft98-style download listings (metadata only), TGJU prices, Iranian crypto exchange prices, Milli.gold gold prices, Tehran Stock Exchange data, ten news sites, Iranian earthquakes, the qavanin.ir laws database and the tax administration's public services, plus PayPing and Bale for the user's own accounts, all unofficial and open source; ExirYab's official server for its doctor directory; Pasavard's official hosted server for hourly-tracked Digikala and Snappshop prices (no sign-in, affiliate links); and SwapWallet's official hosted server for the user's own crypto wallet, where swaps, transfers and withdrawals need the user's approval in Telegram. Prices in Toman. Site servers are read-only. Run any package server with `uvx <name>-mcp`; add Pasavard (`https://pasavard.ir/api/mcp`) and SwapWallet (`https://swapwallet.app/mcp`, OAuth sign-in) by URL. Also a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`iran-mcp`): `claude plugin install <name> --marketplace sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp`, one plugin per server (MCP server + skill) plus bundles such as `iran-all`. Skills for other agents: `npx skills add sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/AGENTS.md): which server for which task, rules, install
- [TOOLS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/TOOLS.md): every tool with a one-line summary
- [servers.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/servers.json): machine-readable catalog (package, version, env vars, tools)
- [.mcp.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/.mcp.json): config for all servers
- [marketplace.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code plugin marketplace, one plugin per server plus bundles
- [PLUGINS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/PLUGINS.md): plugins and skills, agent compatibility, update flow
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/README.md): overview (English)
- [README.fa.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/awesome-iran-mcp/main/README.fa.md): overview (Persian)

## Servers

- [digikala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/digikala-mcp): Digikala, Iran's largest online store
- [torob-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/torob-mcp): Torob price comparison: every Iranian shop's price for a product, price history, deal checks
- [basalam-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/basalam-mcp): Basalam marketplace of small shops: products, cheapest offers, shops, reviews
- [technolife-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/technolife-mcp): Technolife electronics, cash and installment prices
- [masterkala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/masterkala-mcp): MasterKala gadgets and accessories
- [shopino-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/shopino-mcp): Shopino fashion marketplace
- [banimode-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/banimode-mcp): Banimode fashion: prices, sizes in stock, reviews, flash sales
- [baneh-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/baneh-mcp): Baneh (baaneeh.com) in-stock home appliances, TVs and tools: cheapest price, brands, reviews
- [divar-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/divar-mcp): Divar classified ads: homes, cars, phones, fair-price checks
- [khanoumi-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/khanoumi-mcp): Khanoumi cosmetics and perfume
- [asalbanoo-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/asalbanoo-mcp): Asal Banoo cosmetics and hair care
- [snapp-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/snapp-mcp): Snappfood food delivery and SnappMarket groceries (snappfood.ir, snapp.market)
- [okala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/okala-mcp): Okala groceries from nearby stores
- [tapsifood-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tapsifood-mcp): Tapsi Food dishes and restaurants, menus, flash deals
- [mrbilit-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/mrbilit-mcp): MrBilit flights, trains, buses, taxis, hotels
- [flytoday-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/flytoday-mcp): Flytoday flights, trains, buses, hotels, villas, CIP, eSIM, visas
- [jabama-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/jabama-mcp): Jabama stays, tours, events (jabama.com, jabama.tours, jabama.events)
- [otaghak-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/otaghak-mcp): Otaghak villas and cottages
- [paziresh24-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/paziresh24-mcp): Paziresh24 doctors and appointments
- [doctoreto-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/doctoreto-mcp): Doctoreto doctors, clinics, labs
- [exiryab-mcp](https://github.com/sshnevis/exiryab-mcp): ExirYab doctor directory, official (find a doctor by name, city, specialty; clinics, phones, hours, map)
- [taaghche-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/taaghche-mcp): Taaghche ebooks and audiobooks
- [fidibo-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/fidibo-mcp): Fidibo ebooks and audiobooks
- [30book-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/30book-mcp): 30book printed books
- [maktabkhooneh-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/maktabkhooneh-mcp): Maktabkhooneh Persian online courses: search, free and cheapest courses, deals, curricula, reviews (tools `mkh_*`)
- [iran-apps-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-apps-mcp): Android apps on Cafe Bazaar and Myket: search, compare across both stores, top lists
- [iran-downloads-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-downloads-mcp): metadata-only search of Soft98, P30Download, Downloadly and VGDL (item page links, never download links)
- [tgju-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tgju-mcp): TGJU live gold, coin, currency and crypto prices with daily history
- [iran-crypto-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-crypto-mcp): Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin, Ramzinex, Tabdeal, OMPFinex and Exir public market data in Toman: price comparison, order books, trades, candles, top movers
- [milligold-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/milligold-mcp): Milli.gold live 18k gold price, history and platform statistics
- [tsetmc-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tsetmc-mcp): Tehran Stock Exchange and Iran Fara Bourse (tsetmc.com) quotes, movers, order book, history, indices, real versus legal trading (prices in Rial)
- [iran-news-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-news-mcp): news from Mehr, Khabaronline, Hamshahri, Tabnak, Entekhab, Asriran, Zoomit, Digiato, Varzesh3, Khabarvarzeshi: headlines, search, full article text
- [iran-quake-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-quake-mcp): earthquakes in Iran from USGS, EMSC and IRSC: latest, strongest, history, stats
- [qavanin-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/qavanin-mcp): qavanin.ir national laws database: search, full text, articles, amendments
- [iran-tax-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-tax-mcp): tax administration public services (tax.gov.ir, stuffid.tax.gov.ir, regulation.tax.gov.ir): e-invoice goods IDs and VAT, activity codes, property values, tax laws and circulars
- [payping-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/payping-mcp): PayPing merchant account (token, can write)
- [bale-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/bale-mcp): Bale messenger bot (token, can write)
- [pasavard-mcp](https://github.com/ashkancapella/pasavard-mcp): Pasavard hourly-tracked Digikala and Snappshop prices, official and hosted (no sign-in; affiliate and cashback links)
- [swapwallet-mcp](https://github.com/SwapWallet/swapwallet-mcp): SwapWallet crypto account, official and hosted (OAuth sign-in; swaps, transfers and withdrawals need Telegram approval)
